security.summary:
security lens over LEAN-WORKFLOW (97 product path(s), 5736c18..fa63c3d, Codex via the autoreview skill): 4 blocking, 2 non-blocking. Native approval can write through an unconstrained plan path, and POSIX context capture does not enforce the required parent/delete-access and pathname-identity boundary.

The cold-to-final amendment bridge is not mechanically complete: one arbitrary amendment can authorize otherwise unexplained plan replacement, weakening the approval trust boundary.

No concrete security vulnerability is demonstrated here; the missing amendment-chain regression is reported as a quality test gap.

No credential exposure or directly exploitable implementation defect is shown here; the authority-related gaps are reported as missing regression coverage.

A refusal during launch-configuration lookup leaves an already-created private snapshot containing the exact supplied context on disk, violating the promised cleanup boundary. No credential material is present in the supplied change.

Cold-read findings are read from mutable output bytes without verifying a terminally recorded content identity, allowing the evidence used by the approval gate to diverge from the actual launched result.

No credential exposure or direct production vulnerability is shown, but the context-file regression leaves the security-relevant single-snapshot/TOCTOU guarantee unverified.
